    AccountAuthorizationService
    Service providing reusable authorization checks on accounts for the authenticated client.
    AccountBalance
    DTO that represents the balance of an account.

    AccountClient
    Client for interacting with account-related endpoints.

    Configuration class for the AccountClient.

    REST controller for managing accounts.
    AccountGlobalExceptionHandler
    Global exception handler for Account app.
    AccountLockedException
    Exception thrown when an account is locked.

    Opens and funds a newly registered client's first account once the registration has committed. account-app reads the client's status from the database, so it cannot see the client before then.
    AccountRepository
    Interface for managing accounts in the system.
    AccountRepository
    Interface repository for accessing read-only Account entities

    An account with nothing in it, and when it became empty.

    Service for opening accounts on behalf of the authenticated client.

    Data Transfer Object for account validation information.
    AccountValidationDto
    Data transfer object representing the validation details of an account.
    AuthController
    Controller for handling authentication requests such as login.
    AuthService
    Service for handling authentication logic, including login and account lock management.
    BalanceController
    Controller for handling balance-related operations.
    BalanceResponse
    DTO that represents the balance response for an account, including individual account balances and the total balance by currency.
    BalanceService
    Service for handling balance-related operations such as retrieving account balances, performing deposits, and executing withdrawals.
    CashLedgerEntry
    Entity to represent an entry into the cash ledger.
    CashLedgerRepository
    Repository for cash ledger entries.
    CashLedgerRepository.AccountTotal
    Interface representing the total cash amount for an account and currency.
    CashMovementRequest
    Represents a request to move cash into or out of an account.
    CashTransactionResponse
    Represents the response for a cash transaction, including details of the transaction and the resulting balance.
    CashTransferRequest
    Request to move cash between two accounts owned by the authenticated client.
    CashTransferResponse
    Result of a transfer between two accounts.
    Client
    Client entity representing client in IAM
    ClientCredentials
    Represents the client credentials for authentication purposes.
    ClientCredentialsRepository
    Interface for managing client credentials in the IAM system.
    ClientProfileController
    Controller exposing the authenticated client's own profile, so the UI can show who is signed in without the login response or the JWT having to carry profile fields, and letting the client update it.
    ClientProfileController.ClientProfileResponse
    The client's display profile; leaves out SSN and date of birth.
    ClientProfileController.UpdateSettingsRequest
    The settings a client can change; currentPassword is needed to change email or password.
    ClientRegisteredEvent
    Published when a client registration is saved, so the client's first account can be opened and funded once the registration has committed.
    ClientRegistrationController
    Controller responsible for handling client registration requests and managing related exceptions. maps to the /api/iam/v1/clients endpoint.
    ClientRegistrationController.RegistrationRequest
    Represents the client registration request containing all necessary client details for registering a new client in the IAM system.
    ClientRegistrationController.RegistrationResponse
    Represents the response returned after a successful client registration.
    ClientRepository
    Interface for managing clients in the IAM system.
    ClientSessionController
     
    ClientSessionRepository
     
    ClientSessionValidator
     
    ClientStatus
    Read-only view of a client's status in the iam schema. account-app never writes to it; it only needs the status to decide how a newly opened account starts out.
    ClientStatusRepository
    Read-only lookup of a client's status.
    CommonCorsConfiguration
    Shared CORS configuration provider across services.
    CreateAccountRequest
    Request to open another account for the authenticated client.
    CurrentQuoteClient
    HTTP Client that fetches the latest quote for an instrument from the market data service with caller JWT token forwarded.
    CurrentQuoteService
    Supplies the current market quote an order is priced against at execution time, rejecting quotes that are too old to reflect the market.
    Execution
    Represents the execution record of an order in the trading system.
    Execution.Status
    Enum describing the status of an execution
    ExecutionItem
    Execution item for transferring execution details between different layers of the application.
    ExecutionRepository
    Repository interface for managing Execution entities.
    FillRecorder
    Writes everything a fill leaves behind: the FILLED execution, the cash settlement and holding update (delegated to account-app via AccountClient), and its position movement in the audit ledger.
    GbmPriceGenerator
    Generates simulated prices using discretized Geometric Brownian Motion.
    GlobalExceptionHandler
    Global exception handler for the IAM application.
    IamApplication
    Main class for the IAM Spring Boot application
    IamSecurityConfig
    Security configuration for the IAM application This class defines the JWT authentication and CORS settings, security filter chain, password encoder, and exception handling for unauthorized access.
    InactiveAccountDetector
    Nightly job that flags accounts empty for longer than the threshold and clears accounts that no longer are.
    Instrument
    Represents a financial instrument in the trading system (trading.instruments).
    Instrument
    Represents a financial instrument in the trading system (trading.instruments).
    InstrumentRepository
    Repository interface for managing Instrument entities.
    InstrumentRepository
    Repository interface for managing Instrument entities.
    InvalidCredentialsException
    Exception thrown when the provided credentials are invalid.
    JwtAuthenticationEntryPoint
    AuthenticationEntryPoint that writes standard unauthorized JSON response when JWT auth fails or is missing.
    JwtAuthenticationFilter
    Filter that authenticates requests using JWT tokens
    JwtService
    Service for generating and validating JSON Web Tokens (JWTs).
    JwtService.TokenIdentity
     
    LoginRequest
    Record to represent a login request in the IAM system.
    LoginResponse
    Record to represent a login response in the IAM system.
    MarketDataApplication
    Spring Boot entry point for the market data service: simulates instrument prices, ingests them into quotes and OHLC candles, and exposes them over REST and SSE.
    MarketDataClientConfig
    Configures the HTTP client account-app uses to reach the market data service.
    MarketDataClientConfig
    Configures the HTTP client order-app uses to reach the market data service.
    MarketDataGlobalExceptionHandler
    Translates exceptions raised anywhere in the market data service into a consistent JSON error body.
    MarketDataSecurityConfig
    Configures Spring Security for the market data service: stateless JWT authentication (reusing iam-app's JwtService) for every endpoint except health and error.
    MarketSimulationEngine
    Simulates instrument prices using Geometric Brownian Motion, ticking every active instrument on a fixed schedule and publishing a PriceTickEvent per tick.
    Order
    Represents a trading order placed for a specific instrument.
    Order.Side
    Represents the side of the order, either BUY or SELL.
    Order.Status
    The status of the order matching the database check constraint: SUBMITTED, ACCEPTED, REJECTED, FILLED.
    OrderApplication
    Main entry point for the Order application.
    OrderGlobalExceptionHandler
    Global exception handler for Order app.
    OrderHistoryController
    Controller for handling order history related requests.
    OrderHistoryItem
    Record to represent an order history item in the order system.
    OrderHistoryService
    Service for retrieving order history for clients.
    OrderRepository
    Repository interface for accessing Order entities from the database.
    OrderSecurityConfig
    Security configuration for the Order app.
    OrderSubmissionController
    REST controller for order submission.
    OrderSubmissionRequest
    Request payload for submitting an order.
    OrderSubmissionResponse
    Response payload returned upon order submission and immediate execution processing.
    OrderSubmissionResponse.ExecutionDto
    Constructs an instance of ExecutionDto with the specified execution details.
    OrderSubmissionService
    Service to orchestrate the order submission and immediate execution lifecycle.
    PendingFillRecovery
    Finishes booking live fills that a partial platform failure left part-way, so the trade record always ends up agreeing with cash and holdings.
    PortfolioController
    Controller for whole-portfolio views of the authenticated client's accounts.
    PortfolioHistoryResponse
    The authenticated client's total portfolio value (cash plus holdings at market) over a range.
    PortfolioHistoryResponse.Point
    One valued point in time.
    PortfolioHistoryService
    Values the authenticated client's portfolio over a time range.
    PortfolioRange
    A chartable portfolio time range and the candle width used to value it.
    Position
    Represents a trading position of a specific account and instrument.
    PositionController
    REST controller for managing trading positions of accounts.
    PositionId
    Represents the composite primary key for a trading position, consisting of an account ID and an instrument ID.
    PositionItem
    Represents a trading position item within an account, including details about the instrument and the position quantity and cost.
    PositionMovement
    Represents an entry in the position movements ledger (trading.position_movements).
    PositionMovement
    Represents an entry in the position movements ledger (trading.position_movements).
    PositionMovementRepository
    Repository interface for managing PositionMovement entities.
    PositionMovementRepository
    Repository interface for managing PositionMovement entities.
    PositionRepository
    Repository interface for managing trading positions of accounts.
    PositionRepository.PositionRow
    Interface representing a row of position data retrieved from the database.
    PositionService
    Service class for managing trading positions within client accounts.
    PositionsResponse
    Response DTO for representing the positions of an account.
    PriceCandle
    Represents one OHLC candle aggregated from the live simulation tick stream for an instrument, over a fixed-width time bucket.
    PriceCandle.Key
    The composite primary key of a candle.
    PriceCandleAccumulator
    Aggregates the live tick stream into fixed-width OHLC candles instead of persisting every tick, keeping table growth predictable (bucket count/day instead of tick count/day).
    PriceCandleBulkWriter
    Writes a large set of new candles in one transaction, as fast as the database allows.
    PriceCandleRepository
    Interface to represent the repository for OHLC price candles in the market data system.
    PriceCandleResponse
    API representation of one OHLC candle.
    PriceCandleRetention
    Drops candles that have aged out of their width's retention window, so the table reaches a steady size instead of growing for as long as the service runs.
    PriceController
    Exposes the simulated latest prices and OHLC candle history for instruments.
    PriceHistoryBackfill
    Generates a synthetic price history for instruments that have none, so charts have something to draw before the live simulation has been running long enough to produce it.
    PriceHistoryClient
    Fetches candle history and latest prices from the market data service, for valuing holdings over time.
    PriceHistoryClient
    Fetches candle history and latest prices from the market data service, for valuing holdings over time.
    PriceHistoryClient.CandleClose
    One candle's close, the only field valuation needs.
    PriceHistoryClient.CandleClose
    One candle's close, the only field valuation needs.
    PriceResponse
    Record to represent the latest simulated price for an instrument.
    PriceState
    In-memory snapshot of the latest simulated price for an instrument, and the payload published on PriceTickEvent.
    PriceStreamBroadcaster
    Broadcasts live simulation ticks to subscribed clients over Server-Sent Events, optionally filtered to a subset of symbols per subscriber.
    PriceStreamController
    Exposes the live simulation tick stream as a Server-Sent Events endpoint.
    PriceTickEvent
    Published by MarketSimulationEngine on every simulation tick, so other components can react to newly simulated prices.
    Quote
    Represents a single quote accepted by the ingestion pipeline for an instrument.
    QuoteController
    Exposes the quotes accepted by the market quote ingestion pipeline.
    QuoteFeedMessage
    A parsed, structurally-valid quote feed message.
    QuoteFeedMessageParser
    Parses raw pipe-delimited quote feed lines into QuoteFeedMessage.
    QuoteIngestedEvent
    Published by QuoteIngestionService after a quote is parsed, validated, and persisted, so other components can react to newly ingested quotes.
    QuoteIngestionService
    Ingests raw quote feed messages (today, formatted from the live simulation tick stream by SimulatedQuoteFeedFormatter - swappable for a real feed later): parses, validates, persists, and republishes each accepted quote.
    QuoteParseException
    Thrown when a raw quote feed line is structurally malformed and cannot be parsed.
    QuoteRepository
    Interface to represent the repository for ingested quotes in the market data system.
    QuoteResponse
    Record to represent the latest quote for an instrument, returned by QuoteController.
    QuoteSnapshot
    Record to represent a current market quote fetched from the market data service, used to price an order at execution time.
    QuoteState
    In-memory snapshot of the latest accepted quote for a symbol, and the payload published on QuoteIngestedEvent.
    QuoteUnavailableException
    Thrown when the market data service cannot be reached or returns an error while fetching the quote or price history for an instrument.
    QuoteUnavailableException
    Thrown when the market data service cannot be reached or returns an error while fetching the current quote for an instrument.
    SecurityUtils
    Utility class for interacting with the Spring Security context in Leap Laugh Love services.
    SeededFillService
    Books the fills of seeded orders, priced from market data at the moment each one filled.
    SettlementRequest
    Settlement request DTO for account order settlement
    SettlementRequest
    Data transfer object representing a settlement request for an order.
    SettlementResponse
    Data Transfer Object for settlement response information.
    SettlementResponse
    Data transfer object representing the response of a settlement operation.
    SimulatedInstrument
    Represents the GBM simulation parameters for one instrument: its starting price, drift, volatility, and reproducibility seed.
    SimulatedInstrumentRepository
    Interface to represent the repository for simulated instruments in the market data system.
    SimulatedQuoteFeedFormatter
    Simulates a raw exchange quote feed line by deriving a bid/ask spread around the simulation engine's last price (which has no spread of its own).
    StaleQuoteException
    Thrown when a quote is too old to be traded on.
    TradeSettingsRequest
    Request to save an account's trading settings.
    TradeValidationResult
    Result of validating an order against cash balance or existing position holdings.
    TradeValidationService
    Service providing trade validation logic for order submission.
    TransferController
    Controller for moving cash between the authenticated client's accounts.
    TransferService
    Moves cash between two accounts owned by the authenticated client.
